headline: SDP @ TEX matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is SDP 4.29 at TEX 4.20, with a projected total of 8.49. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward SDP: SDP moved +0.54 runs while TEX moved -0.04, changing the projected margin by +0.58 runs. The projected total climbed +0.50, which points to more offensive expectation than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability dropped -13.8%, so the first-inning read became more YRFI/early-scoring friendly. Pitching context: Nathan Eovaldi has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 3.8 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Samad Taylor, Fernando Tatis Jr., Jake Burger, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Jase Bowen, Rodolfo Durán because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
